official_mechanical_drawing_candidate.evidence: panel-mechanical-source-research.md; corner 87/79 offsets and 7.5 stagger dimensioned, intermediate +/-86 X and +/-87 Y derived from geometry
not_established: rigid printed fit and carrier support/load performance
official_mechanical_drawing_candidate.adoption: Adopt 174 x 158 mm four-corner pattern for next prototype rigid gauge; no enclosure solids changed yet. Withdrawn eight-hole reconstruction remains disabled.

single_panel_trial_carrier.status: v6 (carrier unchanged from v2, plus screw-test, halo-channel, DC-socket and pixel-grid coupons and a cable tunnel gauge in the same job; the only planned test print before the final parts) prepared for the first single-panel fit trial; not a full enclosure or wall-load approval
single_panel_trial_carrier.panel_mounts: Four bores on paper-confirmed 174 x 158 mm pattern; intermediate inserts unused but visible through six 5 mm sight holes (both handedness variants)
single_panel_trial_carrier.single_job: Coupon nested in the carrier's open middle (39.8 mm clear); 201.6 mm square job, >=5 mm XY margin on the MK3S bed in either orientation, before brim/skirt
single_panel_trial_carrier.next_physical_evidence: All-four seating/alignment, sight-hole insert positions, rib/PCB/glue/cable interference, glued pitch/body size, LED-tip-to-insert distance, coupon clearance, actual matching thread and usable engagement
single_panel_trial_carrier.not_implemented: Final carrier-to-bezel/wall attachment, fabric retention and final screw length; four-module assembly still historical
single_panel_trial_carrier.seam_holes: Eight 3.5 mm provisional seam holes, symmetric under X and Y mirror, so one carrier fits every tile
single_panel_trial_carrier.orientation_mark: 8 x 2 x 2 mm notch on the +Y rib; XY in bed view (bosses toward viewer, X right, Y up)
single_panel_trial_carrier.fit_check_method: All eight feet removed; no screws or pressure; flatness on a reference surface, then own-weight rest, 3 mm pin alignment, paper gaps and marker contact per boss
